messages:
Frank (CEO): Quick Q&A follow-up from todays all-hands: leadership wants a short "why we win / why we lose" for GTM. Keep it actionable.

Hannah (PM): From our win/loss interviews: Wins: Dedicated + SLA, transparent cost forecasts, VPC/KMS. Losses: total cost vs self-host, missing on-prem option, no easy model pinning.

Maya (CRO): Sales notes: buyers close when we give throughput numbers and a migration playbook. Deals fall when procurement can't justify premium or needs air-gapped deploy.

Ellie (CS): Support signals: repeated latency variance and no rollback UX cause escalations at renewal. Customers ask for per-request model IDs in logs.

Liam (Eng): Proposed quick fixes: add "pin model" toggle, default canary rollout with automatic fallback on regressions, and include model id in traces. I can draft an RFC.

Ravi (Data): I can tag closed deals with reasons and run counts. Preview: need_onprem=5, sla_commit=11, pin_model=8 since Sept. Will share full table Tue.

Hannah (PM): Proposed priority: 1) On-prem/offline bundle for regulated customers, 2) model pinning & rollback, 3) perf expectations sheet for sales. Owners: Maya, Liam, Ben? Due next week.

Maya (CRO): I'll surface 2 deals that hinge on on-prem.

Liam (Eng): Acknowledged. Will scope minimal ship (air-gapped runtime + KMS hooks).

Ellie (CS): I'll add anonymized support snippets referencing rollback and latency.

ops-bot: created doc playbooks/win-loss/q4-2025 by @Hannah

Frank (CEO): One ask for Ravi: can you estimate "avoidable churn" by missing feature? Board wants a simple metric.

Ravi (Data): I'll model a conservative estimate with confidence intervals and post by Tue.

Hannah (PM): Thanks team  I'll summarize in the follow-up email and link artifacts.
